architecture: ImageVAE (port of ../vae-pytorch-pivot/usv_language/models/image_vae.py): encoder 4x stride-2 conv (1->32->64->128->256) BN+LeakyReLU; fc_latent -> (mu, logvar); decoder fc + 4x stride-2 tconv (256->128->64->32->16) + 2x stride-1 refinement tconv (16->16->1); sigmoid output. BCE reconstruction + KL ELBO.
loss: ELBO = BCE(recon, target) sum-over-pixels / batch + beta * KL sum-over-dim / batch
preprocessing: 1) band-crop to corpus USV band; 2) log1p; 3) per-patch min/max rescale to [0, 1] (refinement D, amplitude stripper compatible with BCE); 4) zero-pad to (image_size, image_size); 5) add channel dim.

padding.strategy: symmetric on freq axis (centers USV band); right-pad-only on time axis (preserves onset at column 0)
